caption: The drawing depicts a neoclassical-style console table with a rectangular white marble top. The tabletop rests on a base constructed of rich reddish-brown wood with gold-colored ornamental details. The frieze under the top is decorated with gold motifs, including symmetrical floral patterns and a central medallion design, flanked by square panels at the corners with matching ornamentation. The table is supported at the front by two white columns with gold-colored Corinthian capitals and bases, and at the back by two rectangular, reddish-brown supports accented by gold details. The lower shelf, which echoes the tabletop's shape, has a reddish-brown surface and is bordered with a green and gold trim. Beneath this shelf are further gold-colored ornamental carvings. The table stands on four paw-shaped feet, each rendered in gray with gold-colored ornamentation above them. The background is plain and cream-colored, and the drawing is bordered by a single, thin rectangular line. There is a signature at the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Console Table
